summary: Concord performs no model resolution: lane dispatch omits --model and the host selects the executing model. Actual readback_model is the sole recorded model evidence; missing or ambiguous readback records a failed attempt. Concord has no routing-policy record, load path, declared legal model set, or substitution guarantee. Migration 44 removes the five declared-side attempt columns and preserves existing rows; capability classes remain documentary labels.
title: Concord performs no model routing
